en.headline: Kai Tak Hospital family clinic bookings open this morning
en.dek: The Hospital Authority said patients can book the new Kai Tak family medicine clinic from this morning, ahead of Monday's opening.
body: The Hospital Authority said bookings for Kai Tak Hospital's Family Medicine Integrated Centre opened on Sunday morning, a day before the clinic starts seeing patients.

The centre, on the first floor of the specialist out-patient clinic block, is due to open on Monday and will offer about 250 family medicine quotas a day at the start. The authority said people with episodic illnesses can book through the Book Family Medicine Clinic function on the HA Go app, or by telephone.

Kai Tak Hospital is opening in phases. Specialist out-patient services in medicine, surgery, neurosurgery and clinical oncology will move across from Queen Elizabeth Hospital in batches from late October, with allied health, pharmacy, pathology and radiology services rolling out through the month.

The authority said the hospital will serve about 1.8 million people in Yau Tsim Mong, Kowloon City, Wong Tai Sin and Kwun Tong. In-patient care, surgery and the accident and emergency department are planned for a second phase in 2028.

zh.headline: 啟德醫院家庭醫學診所今早開始預約
zh.dek: 醫管局表示，啟德醫院家庭醫學綜合中心周一開診，市民由今早起可經HA Go或電話預約偶發性疾病診症。
body: 醫院管理局表示，啟德醫院家庭醫學綜合中心的預約今日（周日）早上開始，中心將於周一投入服務。
中心位於專科門診大樓一樓，初期每日提供約250個家庭醫學診症名額。醫管局指，患有偶發性疾病的市民可經HA Go應用程式的「預約普通科門診」功能，或電話預約系統登記。
啟德醫院分期啟用。伊利沙伯醫院內科、外科、神經外科及臨床腫瘤科的專科門診服務，將由十月下旬起分批遷往新大樓；專職醫療、藥劑、病理及放射診斷服務亦會在十月內逐步開展。
醫管局表示，醫院服務範圍涵蓋油尖旺、九龍城、黃大仙及觀塘，人口約180萬。住院、手術及急症服務屬第二期，計劃於2028年展開。
